run_render_one_block_change: run render_one_block_change.py to render Minecraft vision images from an NPY schematic file with one block changed
run_render_function: run the render function to generate vision and chunky images from a Minecraft world schematic
run_change_one_block: run change_one_block to randomly select and change a block to red wool in a schematic
run_intersect_cube: run intersect_cube to test if a ray from camera to focus intersects a Minecraft block cube
run_ray_intersect_triangle: run ray_intersect_triangle to test if a 3D ray intersects with a triangle defined by three vertices
